notablePrerequisites:
Kediss does not have summoning sickness.
Kediss is one of your commanders.
Your life total is at least 9.
An opponent is unable to block Kediss.
description:
Declare Kediss as an attacker, choosing to attack an opponent unable to block.
Before damage, cast Hatred for {3}{B}{B}, paying eight life and giving Kediss +8/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Tainted Strike for {B}, giving Kediss +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Kediss, causing an opponent to get ten poison counters.
Kediss triggers, causing each other opponent to get ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to lethal infect damage.
